comments.author: just_jumper
comments.body:
Hey guys, I'm a student studying computer science, and I developed a cool project where you can battle and collect AI generated pokemon.

This is a trainer card I’m working on that you can share to show off your team and character. Wondering what you guys think 😁

[https://mirage.game](https://mirage.game/)

Game screenshot:

https://preview.redd.it/p51k4lzygnlb1.png?width=2126&format=png&auto=webp&s=c9ce0fa380a7d12f06af6646acfce4c0d8e258df

comments.author: thoughtlow
comments.body:
Hey again, looks cool!

Can players pick their 6 favorite or is that their current team?

Maybe tweak the pokemon frames a bit? I think thats the only part that seems slightly off, not sure what it is exactly, either the thick black borders, maybe rounnd them ever so slightly? or maybe just thinner border and very low opacity bg color? idk. maybe worth experimenting with. 

goodluck!

replies.author: just_jumper
replies.body: Hey! I kept it as current team so its easy for the player. Yeah I think there some tweaks like that all around. Thanks for the feedback :)
